page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The system provides 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, operating with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, which means hyperthreading is disabled to ensure dedicated compute resources.

This instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

Given its high memory capacity and dedicated physical cores, the ecs.ebmr7.32xlarge offers high resource density for enterprise workloads. The absence of hyperthreading ensures predictable CPU performance without resource sharing. This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, in-memory caching, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data processing workloads.
